A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same A-Mem study. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete Appendices A–C support reliable comparison despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: v4 reports original LoCoMo evaluations across six foundation models, component ablations, retrieval-parameter experiments, and memory-embedding analyses.

after.justification: v7 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark comparisons and supplementary results and analyses in the appendices.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4, Equations 1–10, and Appendix C retain the same procedure and prompts. Figure 2 now depicts embedding retrieval already specified in v4 and explicitly describes linked-memory access; these documentation changes do not establish a revised algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate LoCoMo with the same single-hop, multi-hop, temporal, open-domain, and adversarial question categories. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Tables 1, 3, and 4 retain the same evaluated comparators: LoCoMo, ReadAgent, MemoryBank, and MemGPT. Changes in their typography do not alter comparator membership.

E3.justification: The reported 7,512-question evaluation, six foundation models, six metrics, embedding model, and experimental procedures are unchanged. Table 5 retains every model/category retrieval setting, and the sensitivity experiment still tests k values from 10 to 50.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the LG/ME ablations in Table 2, retrieval-parameter analysis in Figure 3, t-SNE analyses in Figures 4–5, and the Q/A example in Appendix C.4. Their analytical questions and evidence are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests. The tables retain the same point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–4 match, including A-Mem's GPT-4o-mini multi-hop F1 of 45.85 and BLEU-1 of 36.67. The sensitivity plots, t-SNE plots, and Appendix C.4 prediction and reference are also retained.

T1.justification: The method equations and mathematical definitions in Equations 1–10 and the metric formulas in Equations 11–25 are equivalent across versions. No formal assumption, theorem, proof, or derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about autonomous note construction, linking, memory evolution, and performance across six foundation models. The scientific contribution's scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: The interpretations of multi-hop performance, token efficiency, component contributions, retrieval tradeoffs, and embedding organization are retained. Section 6 preserves the same limitations concerning underlying LLM capabilities and text-only interactions.

D1.justification: v7 adds an AIOS repository pointer and states that the production-ready memory system is included in AIOS, alongside the two retained code links. Figure 2 additionally documents automatic access to linked memories. Existing implementation settings and appendix prompts remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to memory systems, agentic RAG, and Zettelkasten are retained. Added bibliographic URLs, dates, and ISBN information concern existing references rather than new research positioning.

P1.justification: Most prose and section ordering remain unchanged. Limited edits include the expanded Figure 2 caption, author order and affiliation/contact updates, pluralized conclusion and limitation headings, citation formatting, and a template acknowledgment.

P2.justification: v7 replaces the two-column main text and references with a single-column design, adds a shaded title panel and styled headers, and rearranges figure panels and appendix displays. Figure 2 is redrawn with embedding labels, while Figure 5 and Table 5 are separated onto different pages. This is a document-wide visual redesign.

improvement.justification: v7 corrects Figure 2's keyword-generation depiction to match the embedding retrieval already specified in Section 3.4, clarifies linked-memory access, and adds AIOS software-access information. These provide a limited gain in clarity and usability without changing the scientific evidence. The redesign also introduces sparse appendix pagination, including a nearly empty second contents page, which limits the presentation benefit.
